title: Largest part slice
statement: Let $r$ be a positive integer, let $k$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $R$ be a finite set of vertices partitioned into $2r$ parts, each containing $k$ possible vertices. The number of vertices of $R$ in any one part is at most the number in the part selected to have largest such count.
hypotheses_covered: R is a finite subset of the vertices in 2r parts, each with k possible vertices
part is any one of the 2r parts
